name: governed-but-unevidenced-and-ungoverned
why: Two claims from the same document end in different states: one an obligation happens to govern (so it is merely unevidenced), and one no obligation governs at all (so it is unbacked). Collapsing those two states is how a checklist review passes a document it never checked.
document:
# Vendor Card

## Claims

We ensure that all vendor scoring is reproducible.
We monitor vendor drift quarterly.

obligations.statement: log retention must be declared and bounded
